cases.disposition_reason: --page textutilities opens the playground with the sidebar on Text utilities. Keyboard ] from Overview and a sidebar click reach the same crumb.
cases.label: Text utilities
cases.return_path: sidebar selection returns to Overview and keyboard [ ] can leave and re-enter the route

cases.disposition_reason: Playground is the visible Text utilities section at 120 by 40, with the width-20 helpers and the property sheet.
Playground at 120 by 40 shows ui::text at width 20, payments-platform/s…, the wrap sample, and the Host row.
cases.expected_results: The playground shows ui::text at width 20, payments-platform/s…, keep_indent true, and the Host row db-primary.pay….
cases.forbidden_effects: A different section caption is active, or the width-8 samples payment… and width_capped 9 are visible.
cases.action_sequence: Launch showcase --page textutilities --motion paused at 120x40 and activate the playground tab.

cases.disposition_reason: Playground at 80 by 24 shows the clipped helpers, including payments-platfor…. The header draws no 80×24 chip.
cases.expected_results: The playground shows the clipped helpers, including payments-platfor…, and the header has no 80×24 chip.
cases.forbidden_effects: The wide truncation payments-platform/s…, the 80×24 chip, or another section caption is visible.
cases.action_sequence: Launch showcase --page textutilities --motion paused at 80x24 and activate the playground tab.

cases.disposition_reason: Options is the visible section at 120 by 40. Every control is at its default: width 20, sheet default, wrap default, spoken, case off, nav default, copy y, track page, gap 1, reveal tooltip.
Options at 120 by 40 shows all ten controls at those defaults, including Reveal and Scrollbar gap.
cases.expected_results: The options section shows width 20, sheet default, wrap default, spoken, case off, nav default, copy y, track page, gap 1, and reveal tooltip.
cases.forbidden_effects: A playground helper or another section caption is the active content, or a control shows a non-default value.
cases.action_sequence: Launch showcase --page textutilities --motion paused at 120x40 and activate the options tab.

cases.disposition_reason: Options at 80 by 24 shows the controls through Copy key and the Track click label. Reveal and Scrollbar gap are off-screen, and there is no 80×24 chip.
cases.expected_results: The options section shows the defaults through Copy key. Reveal and Scrollbar gap are off-screen.
cases.forbidden_effects: Reveal, Scrollbar gap, or the 80×24 chip is visible, or a shown control is not at its default.
cases.action_sequence: Launch showcase --page textutilities --motion paused at 80x24 and activate the options tab.

cases.disposition_reason: States at 120 by 40 draws rest, focused, loading, error, overflow, and narrow. Motion stays paused because the loading row's spinner does not settle under normal motion, and a paused press flash never expires.
States at 120 by 40 shows those six rows, the focus bar on focused, and the Facts and Narrow labels columns. Motion stays paused so the loading spinner settles.
cases.expected_results: The states section shows rest, focused, loading, error, overflow, and narrow, with the focus bar only on focused.
cases.forbidden_effects: Hover, pressed, focus + hover, selected, disabled, busy, editing, or empty is a grid row, or rest draws the focus bar.
cases.action_sequence: Launch showcase --page textutilities --motion paused at 120x40 and activate the states tab.

cases.disposition_reason: States at 80 by 24 shows rest, focused, loading, error, and overflow. The narrow row and the Narrow labels column are off-screen. The header draws no 80×24 chip.

cases.forbidden_effects: The narrow row, Narrow labels, or the 80×24 chip is visible.
cases.action_sequence: Launch showcase --page textutilities --motion paused at 80x24 and activate the states tab.

cases.disposition_reason: Compare levels reached no color at 120 by 40 after the 256 and 16 bands. The 80 by 24 frame is the settled screen, still on no color, not the first paint after the shrink. Turning compare off restores the states grid and leaves every option at its default.
cases.action_sequence: Turn Compare levels on, scroll the bands, narrow the terminal, then turn Compare levels off.
cases.expected_results: The 120 by 40 frame shows no color after the 256 and 16 bands. The settled 80 by 24 frame still shows no color. After compare is turned off, the options are unchanged.
cases.forbidden_effects: The narrow frame is the first paint after the shrink, or leaving Compare levels changes an option value or the selected page.

cases.disposition_reason: textutilities.width=8 shows ui::text at width 8, payment…, payme…ff, the eight-cell clip payments, width_capped 9, and wrap_with at 24. The other controls stay at their defaults. width_capped prints cap plus one.
cases.combination_reason: Execute the default and one non-default boundary. Execute another option in combination only when needs declares a dependency. Unrelated options do not form a Cartesian product.
cases.action_sequence: Set textutilities.width from its default to another listed value through --opt or the Options control.
cases.expected_results: Width 8 shows ui::text at width 8, payment…, payme…ff, clip payments, width_capped 9, and wrap_with at 24.
cases.forbidden_effects: The width-20 title, payments-platform/s…, width_capped 21, or another option's control value is visible.

cases.disposition_reason: textutilities.sheet=narrow-labels shows Repli… and Conne… and more of the host value. The width-20 truncation on the left stays payments-platform/s….
cases.combination_reason: Execute the default and one non-default boundary. Execute another option in combination only when needs declares a dependency. Unrelated options do not form a Cartesian product.
cases.action_sequence: Set textutilities.sheet from its default to another listed value through --opt or the Options control.
cases.expected_results: Narrow labels shows Repli…, Conne…, and db-primary.payments.inter…. The left column still shows payments-platform/s….
cases.forbidden_effects: The full label Replication lag or the default host clip db-primary.pay… is visible, or the width control leaves 20.

cases.expected_results: Plain wrap shows keep_indent false and An indented block keeps its indent.
cases.forbidden_effects: The title keep_indent true is visible, or another option's control value changes.

cases.combination_reason: Execute the default and one non-default boundary. Execute another option in combination only when needs declares a dependency. Unrelated options do not form a Cartesian product.

cases.combination_reason: Execute the default and one non-default boundary. Execute another option in combination only when needs declares a dependency. Unrelated options do not form a Cartesian product.

cases.disposition_reason: textutilities.copy_key=c shows copy c in the readout and c Copy in the footer. The status is Copied Host and the last action is Copy(Host), the property label. The card meta stays Enter activates · y copies, and the focused row hint stays y copy.
cases.combination_reason: Execute the default and one non-default boundary. Execute another option in combination only when needs declares a dependency. Unrelated options do not form a Cartesian product.
cases.action_sequence: Set textutilities.copy_key from its default to another listed value through --opt or the Options control.
cases.expected_results: Copy key c shows copy c, c Copy, Copied Host, and Copy(Host). The card meta still says y copies, and the focused row still says y copy.
cases.forbidden_effects: The readout says copy y, the status copies the host value, or the card meta changes its y copies hint.

cases.disposition_reason: textutilities.track_click=jump changes the Options control to jump. The 120 by 40 playground glyphs stay the same, because the readout clips at track… before the click mode.
cases.combination_reason: Execute the default and one non-default boundary. Execute another option in combination only when needs declares a dependency. Unrelated options do not form a Cartesian product.
cases.action_sequence: Set textutilities.track_click from its default to another listed value through --opt or the Options control.
cases.expected_results: The Options control shows jump. The playground glyphs match the default page, and the readout still ends at track….
cases.forbidden_effects: The playground readout shows Jump or Page, or a different option's control changes.

cases.disposition_reason: textutilities.scrollbar_gap=0 changes the Options control to 0. The playground does not paint scrollbar_gap, so the 120 by 40 glyphs stay the same.
cases.combination_reason: Execute the default and one non-default boundary. Execute another option in combination only when needs declares a dependency. Unrelated options do not form a Cartesian product.
cases.action_sequence: Set textutilities.scrollbar_gap from its default to another listed value through --opt or the Options control.
cases.expected_results: The Options control shows 0. The playground glyphs match the default page, and scrollbar_gap is not painted.
cases.forbidden_effects: The playground paints scrollbar_gap, or a different option's control changes.

cases.disposition_reason: textutilities.reveal=inline changes the Options control to inline. The playground readout clips before the reveal mode, so the 120 by 40 glyphs stay the same.
cases.combination_reason: Execute the default and one non-default boundary. Execute another option in combination only when needs declares a dependency. Unrelated options do not form a Cartesian product.
cases.action_sequence: Set textutilities.reveal from its default to another listed value through --opt or the Options control.
cases.expected_results: The Options control shows inline. The playground glyphs match the default page, and InlineWrap is not painted.
cases.forbidden_effects: The playground paints InlineWrap or reveal off, or a different option's control changes.

cases.disposition_reason: The before frame shows the width-20 helpers and the property sheet. After y on the focused Host row, the status is Copied Host and the last action is Copy(Host). Truncation, crumb fit, wrap, and the spoken duration sample stay. The copy is the property label, not the host value.
cases.action_sequence: Activate and copy property rows. Exercise fit, wrap, case, duration, and reveal.
cases.expected_results: The before frame shows the width-20 helpers and the property sheet. The after frame shows Copied Host and Copy(Host). Truncation, crumb fit, wrap, and the spoken duration sample stay.
cases.forbidden_effects: The copy status shows the host value or Copy(Port), or the width, wrap, or spoken duration sample changes.
